entities.name: CSFB response
entities.description: Information element that indicates whether the UE accepts or rejects a paging for CS fallback. It is a type 1 information element with a specific bit layout.

entities.name: CSFB response IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier for the CSFB response information element, located in bits 5-8 of octet 1.

entities.name: CSFB response value
entities.description: Value field in bits 1-2 of octet 1 that indicates the CS fallback response: 001 = CS fallback accepted by the UE, 000 = CS fallback rejected by the UE. All other values are reserved.

entities.name: CS fallback accepted by the UE
entities.description: Condition where the UE accepts CS fallback, indicated by CSFB response value bits set to 001.

entities.name: CS fallback rejected by the UE
entities.description: Condition where the UE rejects CS fallback, indicated by CSFB response value bits set to 000.

relations.description: The CSFB response information element contains the IEI identifier field.
The CSFB response information element contains the response value field.
The CSFB response value field is guarded by the condition where CS fallback is accepted (value 001).
The CSFB response value field is guarded by the condition where CS fallback is rejected (value 000).
